tagline: STIHL power equipment for Waiheke Island locals
heroSubheading: Your local dealer for sales, service, and parts.
aboutHtml:
We're STIHL SHOP Waiheke, your local dealer for quality outdoor power equipment. Ben established the shop to give Waiheke access to genuine STIHL products and the reliable support that keeps your gear running well for years.

We stock STIHL's full range, from chainsaws and brushcutters to hedge trimmers and more, all genuine products we stand behind. Bring your equipment in when it needs servicing, repairs, or parts and we'll keep it running well. We have the knowledge to work on your gear properly. You'll get straight advice about what works for your situation, not just sales talk.

Come in and see us when you're on the island. We're open Monday to Friday 8am to 5pm, and Saturday mornings 8am to 2pm.
